note: DX9 _FrameMoveBlast restarts the whole group only after _wDeath reaches _iParNum; normal timeline preserves that group restart and per-update frame stepping; DX9 global rand() sequence and visual parity remain unverified

name: SHRINK shared emitter and slot recycle timeline
note: DX9 _CreateShrink shares _fCurTime across dead slots and _FrameMoveShrink re-emits after collision/lifetime; TOP_HISTORICAL_SHRINK_TIMELINE replays slot order and actual EffectSystem dt with deterministic per-slot random values; normal, visual parity unverified

name: BLAST3 with multiple animation frames
note: DX9 advances one frame per controller update; normal BLAST3 parent timeline follows actual EffectSystem steps; visual parity remains unverified

name: BLAST3 nested .eff controller clocks
note: DX9 advances the child CMPModelEff before BLAST3 particles; normal group timeline advances per-child frames and UV/texture clocks on each EffectSystem step; visual parity is unverified

name: MODEL with multiple curve frames
note: DX9 CMPParticle::GetCurFrame advances at most one frame per FrameMove and drops residual time; normal discrete timeline, texture and actual cadence still need comparison

name: Delayed MODEL with multiple curve frames
note: DX9 checks IsDelay before FrameUpdate and advances the delay clock during Render afterward; the update that crosses delay is skipped whole. The normal MODEL parent and nested .eff timelines use zero dt on that crossing update, then the full EffectSystem step on the next update.

name: MODEL parent midpoint position
note: DX9 _FrameMoveModel places its single particle at _vPos + range/2; GL maps DX9 X/Y/Z to OpenGL X/Z/Y under this normal switch; visual parity remains pending

name: MODEL nested .eff frame stepping
note: DX9 _FrameMoveModel advances CMPModelEff after each parent update except the parent frame-wrap update; GL analytically sampled nested .eff before this normal per-child timeline

name: MODEL/STRIP finite controller stop
note: DX9 UpdateDelay stops at absolute playTime; delay gates updates but is not added to the stop clock. GL already suppresses rendering at that controller time; this normal also releases the retained effect instance at max(delayTime, playTime), preserving other profiles' longer tails. Unbounded playTime keeps the existing event lifetime.

name: ARRAW nested .eff frame stepping
note: DX9 _FrameMoveArraw advances its one child CMPModelEff once per FrameMove; normal parent and child timelines consume EffectSystem::step(dt); default remains unchanged and visual parity is unverified

name: RIPPLE nonzero emission step
note: DX9 primes a shared _fCurTime to _fStep, emits one dead slot at a time, randomizes each slot life using the serialized divisor and advances one frame per update; normal replay preserves slot order, but rand() stream and model-range/bone paths are not generalized

name: RIPPLE nested .eff frame stepping
note: DX9 calls child CMPModelEff::FrameMove from _FrameMoveRipple; GL has normal per-child frame and controller clocks driven once per RIPPLE update under TOP_HISTORICAL_RIPPLE_POOL

name: RANGE2 per-frame collision/update clock
note: DX9 moves and tests collision once per actual FrameMove(dt); GL retains the nominal-60Hz stateless fallback, while TOP_HISTORICAL_RANGE2_ACTUAL_DT uses per-instance/per-profile updates from EffectSystem::step(dt); player-following anchors and visual parity remain unverified

name: ROUND per-update orbit and curve clock
note: DX9 accumulates one shared orbit angle per FrameMove and each particle advances at most one curve frame; TOP_HISTORICAL_ROUND_TIMELINE replays both from EffectSystem::step(dt); global rand() sequence and visual parity remain unverified

name: ROUND nested .eff controller clock
